jobs.occupation: Truck Drivers (m/f/d) Wanted – Already in the EU? Start your career in Germany (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
jobs.description:
Are you living in the EU and have experience as a truck driver – or are ready to take the wheel professionally? Then hello jobs is your gateway to a secure, well-paid job in Germany’s transport sector.  We’re looking for motivated drivers from all backgrounds. Whether you’re from Italy, Spain, Nigeria, Romania, Ghana, or anywhere else – if you’re living in the EU, we’d love to hear from you.

What We Offer

- Competitive salary: up to €3,000 gross per month plus daily allowances
- Your own truck with a fixed trailer
- Permanent, full-time contract directly with the German employer
- Flexible shift models: 3/1, 4/1, 6/2, 9/3 and others
- Personal support throughout your relocation and onboarding
- Help with housing, registration, paperwork and more

Your Profile

- EU Category CE driver’s license with Code 95
- Valid driver card
- Legal residence in an EU country
- Previous truck driving experience is a plus, but not required
- Willingness to do overnight tours
- Basic German or English – enough to communicate

About hello jobs

hello jobs is an international recruitment agency with a passion for connecting people. We support drivers from all over the world on their way to stable, long-term employment in Germany. Our multilingual team knows the industry and is here to guide you every step of the way.  We welcome applications from people of all genders, nationalities and backgrounds. Your motivation and skills are what matter most.

For an established automotive company with multiple locations in Hamburg and Schleswig-Holstein, we are looking for an experienced professional in the field of automotive mechanics. Do you have practical experience in vehicle technology and would like to apply your skills in a modern working environment with long-term career prospects? Then we look forward to receiving your application.

Your Tasks

- Performing maintenance, repair, and servicing work on vehicles * Diagnosing and resolving technical issues * Carrying out inspections according to manufacturer specifications * Working on premium vehicle brands * Using modern diagnostic equipment and workshop systems * Ensuring high-quality standards throughout all tasks

Your Profile

- Completed vocational training in automotive mechatronics or a comparable qualification * Several years of experience in vehicle technology * Experience with premium brands is an advantage * Strong technical understanding and a careful, precise working style * Reliability and ability to work as part of a team * Basic German skills (A1–A2) or good English skills * Willingness to further improve German language skills

Your Benefits

- Collective agreement-based salary * Company pension scheme * Bike leasing program * Professional training and development opportunities * Modern working environment * Long-term career prospects

How to Apply Successfully

1. Fill out the application form with just a few clicks and send us your resume in English or German. 2. You will receive feedback from hello jobs via email regarding the next steps. 3. If your application matches an open position, we will contact you promptly by phone or WhatsApp. 4. If your application is not successful this time, we will inform you by email. 5. After the initial conversation with your hello jobs advisor, if everything fits, you will begin the selection process with the German company. 6. Upon completing this process, you will receive a written job offer, and your new job in Germany will be within reach.

About hello jobs

You are at the heart of our passion: As an international professional recruitment agency, hello jobs guides you on your career journey. Our team of experienced recruiters understands today’s global job market in all its complexity. We believe in true partnerships, whether between candidates and companies or between our team and you. Your career plan and personal values are at the core of our mission.

Are you ready to start your career as an Aircraft Test Engineer (d/f/m)? This role works directly with state-of-the-art aviation systems. Located in Finkenwerder, you'll join a team tasked with providing Ground Test Instructions (GTIs) and Re-Test Instructions (RTIs) for the A320 family, across sites in Hamburg, Tianjin, and Alabama. Your efforts will directly support progress in the aerospace industry, helping ensure that modifications and functional tests are carried out to the highest standards. In a full-time position, you’ll take on a complex role that combines engineering creativity with operational excellence.

- You will plan and develop functional tests, such as GTIs and RTIs, using construction documents and Ground Test Requirements (GTR).
- You will take part in cross-border coordination and assess whether GTR content is feasible.
- You will track modifications and verify their effect on both existing and newly created GTIs.
- You will make sure GTR is fully applied in aircraft-specific GTIs.
- You will give direct assistance during function test execution and resolve issues in aircraft and test systems.
- You will play a key role in developing and enhancing testing tools and facilities.
- You will plan, carry out, and oversee projects aimed at lowering function test costs.
- You will help improve the test system specifications after any aircraft modifications.
- Drawing on your expertise, you will contribute to solving critical issues, including resolutions related to Ground Test Instructions up to Rejected Take-Off (RTO).
VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:

If you are eager to take on a demanding and technical position in the aviation sector, this role could be ideal for you. To be successful, you will need a solid background in engineering, technical documentation, and troubleshooting within complex aerospace or electronic systems. The qualifications and skills needed for this position are listed below:

- Minimum Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline.
- Minimum 2-3 years of professional experience in aviation, electronics, engineering, or technical documentation.
- Proficiency with tools such as SAP, Taksy/Gesy/Tesy, and zamiz, as well as familiarity with Google Workspace environments.
- Strong technical knowledge of communication and information systems, with more than three years of experience.
- Fluent in English (advanced working proficiency) and German (proficiency).
- Proven ability to understand and assess complex technical designs and workflows.
- A proactive, organized, and results-driven approach to project management and teamwork.
- Excellent communication skills to work effectively across all levels of an organization.
- Willingness to travel internationally 1-2 times per year and occasionally be available on-call.
Benefits:

This full-time role comes with a competitive, well-rounded benefits package aimed at helping you thrive professionally while keeping a healthy balance between work and personal life. Main benefits include:

- An open-ended employment contract for greater job security.
- A 35-hour working week to support work-life balance.
- 30 days of paid annual leave to rest and recover.
- An annual salary based on an appealing Equal Pay model.
- Flexibility for additional hours, either as compensatory time off or financial compensation.

As the Version Planer (d/m/w), you will hold a key position within the A320 Program Management department in Finkenwerder. You will support smooth collaboration and coordination among multiple operational teams, including configuration management, production, engineering, procurement, and transport. Your work will directly support the delivery of important company goals, with a strong focus on meeting customer commitments on time.

- Develop, roll out, track, and oversee the Integrated Programme Planning to ensure it remains robust and relevant.
- Foresee and handle planning deviations to keep project timelines on track and improve financial outcomes.

We are looking for a candidate who has a demonstrated track record of handling complex integrated planning processes in an international and varied environment. Excellent organizational abilities, strong communication, attention to detail, and flexibility are essential to succeed in this role.

- A Bachelor’s degree in engineering, aerospace, mechanical engineering, technical studies, or industrial engineering is required.
- Between 0-3 years of experience in configuration management, engineering, production planning, or project management preferred.

jobs.occupation: Senior Logistics Specialist, Data Center Communities , AWS DC Operations Logistics - VAR (Assistent/in - Logistik)
jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
Be a part of operating the world’s largest cloud computing infrastructure. Amazon Web Services is seeking bright, motivated, hardworking individuals to fill Senior Datacenter Logistics Specialist positions. The ideal candidate possesses a strong work ethic, attention to detail, the ability to meet deadlines, and a commitment to Operational Excellence.

The Senior Logistics Specialist reviews datacenter inventory, in-bound shipments, and ongoing demand to ensure that proper stock levels are maintained in all locations to support build and repair activities. Working with the Logistics Manager, they create plans to optimize the flow of parts through their lifecycle; tracking inventory location, movement, age, and turns. They work closely with Datacenter Operations Technicians and Datacenter Engineers to fulfill parts quickly and accurately. They work with Procurement and Hardware Engineering to purchase new parts and interface directly with vendors to process RMAs and receive replacements. They are responsible for accurate data entry and resolving questions from peer organizations.

The ideal Logistics Specialist will dive deep into data to understand everything about the datacenter asset lifecycle. Working with software development teams, they will contribute to continuous process improvements to deliver on our goals of high availability and low cost. They maintain up-to-date metrics dashboards and will create reports for internal and external suppliers and management as required.

Responsibilities include manual tasks, such as assembling, addressing, stamping and arranging for the shipment of merchandise and materials. They will also assist in daily scheduling of deliveries and pick-ups to and from production locations. In handling incoming shipments, they will have to unpack boxes and verify contents. The Logistic Specialist will be required to keep precise records of all commodities going in and out of company.

Logistics Specialist is expected to understand all aspects of production, adhere to strict safety standards, maintain very high levels of quality and be willing to travel to support other location within and outside the Country.

Key job responsibilities
Your main responsibilities as Senior Logistics Specialist include:
• You will support the Data Center Operations team by maintaining receiving, warehousing, and distribution operations of parts, consumables and other supplies by initiating, coordinating, and enforcing program, operational, and personnel policies and procedures.
• Comply with local warehousing, health and safety and shipping requirements by studying existing and new legislation; enforcing adherence to requirements; advising management on needed actions.
• Safeguard warehouse operations and contents by establishing and monitoring safety and security procedures and protocols.
• Working with Procurement and other Logistics Managers, you will control inventory levels by conducting physical counts and reconciling with inventory management tools.
• Maintain the physical condition of the storage areas by planning and implementing new design layouts; inspecting equipment; issuing work orders for repair and requisitions for replacement.
We work in a high security environment with sensitive equipment and maintaining this security and accountability will be a primary task. They are responsible for the security and tracking of parts within the storage areas and to the end user.
• Contribute to continuous process improvements to deliver on our goals of high availability and low cost. They maintain up-to-date metrics dashboards and will create reports for management as required.

Safety:
• Follow and maintain the highest safety standards and diligently encourage a world-class safety culture. Own the safety initiatives and projects to foster a strong safety culture.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Early Career Talent
When you join Amazon Web Services as a student or recent graduate, you’ll have the chance for your voice to be heard and amplified. That’s because our teams are looking to learn as much from you as you’ll learn from them. Whether you’re graduating with a high school or equivalent diploma, associate degree, bachelor’s degree, MBA, or PhD, we offer a range of early career opportunities across the globe.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience in goods receiving, inventory cycle counts and related auditing and stock control functions
- Experience in logistics

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in supply chain/logistics or related field
- Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
- Experience with data center operations: inventory management, hot/cold aisles, security
- Experience recognizing a challenge and working with a variety of teams and data sources to diagnose the problem and recommend solutions

jobs.occupation: 573787 Business Marketing Manager IGT-Devices (all genders) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule) - Marketing)
jobs.description:
To support our initiatives for further adoption of Philips technology providing Class IA guideline treatment options, we are expanding our International marketing team with a Business Marketing Manager DACH, responsible for the full IGTD product and solutions portfolio.

The Business Marketing Manager is the dedicated field-based marketing owner for the DACH market zone, covering Germany, Austria and Switzerland. This role is accountable for translating international and global marketing strategy into locally relevant market activation, demand generation and adoption across the full IGTD product and solutions portfolio. The individual is expected to operate close to the market, spending significant time in the field with sales teams, customers, clinical partners and regional stakeholders to understand local needs, identify growth opportunities and remove barriers to execution.

The role combines strategic portfolio marketing with hands-on field execution. The Business Marketing Manager will define and drive DACH-specific marketing plans, shape customer engagement programs, support priority account activation, build local proof points and ensure launches, campaigns and market development initiatives are executed with strong local relevance and commercial impact.

As a member of the International Marketing team, you will own specific marketing activities that span the complete international region.

Success in this role requires regular travel and visible presence across the zone. The individual should expect to travel extensively within DACH, approximately 50-60% of time, to engage with customers, KOLs, sales teams, professional societies, congresses, workshops and other in-market activation opportunities.

Your role:

Own the DACH market zone

- Act as the primary marketing owner for Germany, Austria and Switzerland, accountable for local market planning, activation priorities and execution quality. Be present in the field with sales team, and customers to understand adoption barriers, customer needs, competetive dynamics and local growth opportunities.
- Collaborate with global and international marketing, market intelligence, and sales leadership to prioritise target accounts, market segments, and growth opportunities across the portfolio.
- Lead specific marketing capabilities internationally, strengthening the broader International marketing organization.
- Translate strategy into local execution by converting global and international portfolio strategies into DACH-specific messaging, campaigns, engagement formats and sales enablement priorities.
- Drive demand generation and adoption by leading marketing activities that increase awareness, utilization and customer preference for the full IGTD portfolio.

Partner internally, externally and represent the voice of the market

- Partner with sales leadership and field teams to prioritize accounts, shape plans, refine messaging and support commercial objectives.
- Bring structured market insights, customer feedback and competitive intelligence back to the international marketing team to influence activation planning and portfolio priorities.
- Seek and develop opportunities to strengthen Philips’ cardiology value proposition for customers in your region by close partnership with adjacent Philips categories such as the One-IGT unique solution offering.
- Build reference sites, customer testimonials, and clinical proof points that resonate with local audiences. Partner with KOLs and professional societies to strengthen Philips’ position in focus markets.
- Work under limited supervision and broad guidelines, serving as the primary marketing contact for assigned portfolio areas and focus markets.
- Define proposals for the mid-term marketing strategy, identifying key market challenges and opportunities early and implementing business plans and goals accordingly.

You're the right fit if:

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Healthcare, or related field.
- 3–5 years of experience in downstream marketing, preferably in healthcare, medtech, or related industries.
- Demonstrated experience managing a broad product and solutions portfolio (not limited to a single category or technology platform).
- Proven ability to lead dedicated market initiatives – owning the full marketing cycle from strategy to execution within specific geographies.
- Strong execution skills with the ability to adapt global strategies for local impact.
- Excellent presentation, communication, and stakeholder management abilities.
- Knowledge of image-guided therapy, interventional systems, or healthcare technology is a plus.
- Must be fluent in German and English languages.
- Willingness to travel 50–60% of time.

Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is € 126,297.80 – € 159,977.21. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you will have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations.

This role is eligible for Short Term Incentive, with your rewards linked to individual performance and company results. We will share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision.

Benefits include:

- Annual leave: 30 days
- Mobility and devices: subsidized Germany ticket, leasing opportunities for private use (bicycles, cars, smartphones, ...)
- Philips University & Philips in Balance: wide range of professional training courses for personal development and healthcare
- Philips Pension Fund: employer-funded pension plan
- Philips Partnerzeit: two paid weeks off after your partner has given birth
- Philips MyShop: discount on Philips products
- Culture: informal culture, a paid day for voluntary work, various team and cultural activities, etc.

How we work together
Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

About Philips
We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.
• Learn more about our business (https://www.philips.com/a-w/about.html) .
• Discover our rich and exciting history (https://www.philips.com/a-w/about/our-history.html) .
• Learn more about our purpose (https://www.philips.com/a-w/about/environmental-social-governance/our-purpose) .
If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care here (https://www.careers.philips.com/global/en/our-culture) .

jobs.occupation: Postdoc Researcher (f/m/d) in Evolutionary Genomics of Mammals (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre (SBiK-F), starting as of 01 November 2026:

Postdoc Researcher (m/f/d)

in Evolutionary Genomics of Mammals** (m/f/d)**

(Full time / part time** **options available)

﻿

Location: Frankfurt am Main
Employment scope: Full-time; part time options are available
Type of contract: Temporary, limited to 2 years
Remuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E13

The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.

The mission of the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre is to study the complex interactions between biodiversity and climate change.

There is an exciting opportunity for a talented and motivated applicant to join the working group of Prof. Dr. Axel Janke. The applicant will be closely involved in gene flow, evolutionary, population or phylo-genetics to study speciation in mammals (bears, giraffe, kangaroos or allies) at the genomic level and in MSc and BSc teaching. Strong own and proven research interests including other vertebrate groups will be considered.

Your tasks

- Conduct genomic research on mammalian evolution and speciation, including evolutionary, population and phylogenomic analyses
- Investigate phylogenetic relationships, gene flow and genomic signatures of evolutionary and environmental processes using genomic and bioinformatic approaches
- Apply and further develop bioinformatic methods for the analysis of genomic data, including population genomics, genome assembly and species distribution modelling
- Organise and teach university courses and supervise BSc and MSc theses
- Independently prepare and publish research results in peer-reviewed journals and contribute to the acquisition of third-party funding

Your profile

- PhD degree in Biology, Genetics, Bioinformatics or a related field
- Strong interest and proven skills in evolutionary, population or phylogenomics.
- Knowledge of gene-flow analyses and/or drift processes is an advantage
- Experience in population genomics, genome assembly and script programming, including R
- Very good written and oral communication skills in English
- Interest in species distribution modelling, paternal inference, conservation genetics and epigenetics

We offer

- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations
- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution
- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension plan

Senckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, gender, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or disability. Women are particularly encouraged to apply, as they are underrepresented in the field of this position; in the case of equal qualifications and suitability they will be given preference. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.

How to apply?

Please upload your application as a single PDF by 5 October 2026, including:

- CV
- Letter of motivation
- Academic transcripts and certificates/credentials
- Two relevant publications
- Contact details of two potential references

Please compress the files where possible. If the two publications cause the file to exceed the upload limit, they may be uploaded separately.

Contact

Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung
Senckenberganlage 25
60325 Frankfurt am Main

For specific questions about this role, please contact Prof. Dr. Axel Janke ataxel.janke@senckenberg.de

For data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/

Please visit our website at www.senckenberg.de for further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung.

Your Tasks

If you have proven experience with offshore foundation T&I contracts, BIMCO agreements, and marine logistics services, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and contribute your expertise to the successful delivery of complex offshore projects from tendering through execution.

- Management of offshore T&I-related contracts, including Guard Vessels, CTVs, SOVs, and associated marine services (BIMCO-based agreements).

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher Health Economics / Health Data Science  (Psychologe/Psychologin)
jobs.description:
...you're in the middle of it

The position is embedded in EU-MIC (European Coalition for Mental Health Medicines Innovation), a strategic initiative led by the European College of Neuropsychopharmacology (ECNP). EU-MIC aims to address the growing innovation gap in psychopharmacology between Europe and the United States and to examine the structural disparities between mental and somatic health in access to innovative medicines.

A major workstream of the project focuses on the quantification of the direct and indirect societal costs of mental disorders, including:

- healthcare and treatment costs
- sick leave, retirement and disability-related costs
- productivity losses
- presenteeism and absenteeism
- broader social and long-term economic consequences

The resulting evidence will contribute to scientific publications, European policy reports, and advocacy activities targeting regulators, HTA bodies, payers, policymakers, clinicians, patients, and carers.

The position is initially limited to two years, with the possibility of extending it to three years. There is also the opportunity to pursue a habilitation.

Your Role:

- Develop and implement a health-economic data analysis plan within EU-MIC
- Identify, collate, harmonise, and analyse national and international datasets (which, in part, will also be delivered by the supporting companies) and evidence sources
- Model direct and indirect costs of mental disorders across European healthcare systems
- Quantify presenteeism, productivity losses, and wider societal economic impacts
- Conduct systematic evidence reviews, evidence synthesis, and health-economic modelling
- Establish transparent data structures, metadata standards, and reproducible analytical workflows
- Prepare peer-reviewed publications, technical reports, policy briefs, and stakeholder presentations
- Collaborate closely with international experts in psychiatry, health economics, HTA, public affairs, and patient organisations
- Contribute to the strategic development of EU-MIC and future European research and funding initiatives

- Experience in health-economic evaluation, cost-of-illness studies, HTA, or real-world evidence generation is highly desirable
